provenance.code: mpmath closed forms (dimer: 2x2 per Cartesian direction) + pymbd vdw_params

definitions.screening: per direction d: [[1/a, t_d], [t_d, 1/b]]^-1 row sums; t_perp = zeta/R^3, t_par = (-2 zeta + 3 eta)/R^3, zeta = erf(u) - 2u/sqrt(pi) e^-u^2, eta = 4u^3/(3 sqrt(pi)) e^-u^2, u = R/sigma_AB
definitions.energy: sum_d [sqrt(m+D) + sqrt(m-D) - w_A - w_B]/2, m=(w_A^2+w_B^2)/2, D = sqrt(((w_A^2-w_B^2)/2)^2 + (w_A w_B sqrt(a b) t_d)^2)
definitions.london: C6_AB = 3/2 a_A a_B w_A w_B/(w_A+w_B) == TS combination rule
